introduction: The Go AI layer of the `agentspec` package implements the LLM client, prompt template system, and AI agent pipeline that drive PRD assessment, iterative refinement, and sequential artifact generation — porting the Python implementation to Go and wiring it into the `SpecSession` state machine. Note: requirements referencing the Anthropic Go SDK (`github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go`) and `afspec` Go APIs are based on PRD assumptions and should be cross-checked against the installed library versions before implementation.

glossary.AICall: The central LLM interface function that resolves the model, creates a platform-aware client, streams the response, and retries on transient errors.
glossary.AICallOptions: A struct of options passed to AICall, including ModelTier, MaxTokens, Messages, System, Context, CachePolicy, Temperature, Tools, and ToolChoice.
glossary.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: Environment variable holding the API key for direct Anthropic API access.
glossary.AgentError: Richest error type carrying Detail, ErrorCategory, Retryable, HTTPStatus, and an Unwrap() method preserving the original error.
glossary.AgentOption: A functional option type for SpecAgent methods, used to pass spec landscape, dependent interfaces, project directory, and artifact callbacks.
glossary.AssessPRD: A SpecAgent method that sends a PRD to the LLM with the assessment system prompt and submit_assessment tool, returning a validated Assessment.
glossary.Assessment: Go struct capturing PRD quality assessment output: Quality, Summary, Gaps, and Questions.
glossary.AssessmentSystemPrompt: A function that loads the assessment_system prompt template.
glossary.AssessmentTools: Function returning the Anthropic tool definition list for the assessment phase.
glossary.AssessmentUserPrompt: A function that loads and renders the assessment_user prompt template.
glossary.CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK: Environment variable that, when set, causes AICall to create a Bedrock Anthropic client instead of a direct API client.
glossary.CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX: Environment variable that, when set, causes AICall to create a Vertex AI Anthropic client instead of a direct API client.
glossary.CacheDefault: CachePolicy constant indicating ephemeral cache_control injection when the system prompt exceeds the token threshold.
glossary.CacheExtended: CachePolicy constant indicating ephemeral cache_control with a 1-hour TTL when the system prompt exceeds the token threshold.
glossary.CacheNone: CachePolicy constant indicating no cache_control injection.
glossary.CachePolicy: A string type controlling prompt caching behavior: CacheNone, CacheDefault, or CacheExtended.
glossary.DetectProjectLanguage: A function that scans a project directory for manifest files and returns the detected language name and tooling hints.
glossary.FormatSpecLandscape: A function that formats spec landscape entries into markdown tables split into active and archived sections.
glossary.GenerateArtifacts: A SpecAgent method that sequentially generates requirements, test_spec, and tasks artifacts with validation and repair loops.
glossary.GenerateResult: Go struct returned after artifact generation containing Artifacts list, Validation result, and Warnings.
glossary.GenerationSystemPrompt: A function that loads the generation_system prompt template.
glossary.GenerationUserPrompt: A function that loads and renders the generation_user_base and artifact-specific prompt templates.
glossary.LoadPrompt: A function that loads a named prompt template from a project-local override path or the embedded defaults, stripping YAML frontmatter.
glossary.LoadPromptTemplate: A function that loads a prompt template via LoadPrompt and performs safe $variable substitution.
glossary.MarshalJSON: The afspec function used to serialize a validated artifact struct to JSON for writing to disk.
glossary.ModelEntry: A struct holding a model's ID string, ModelTier, and variant string.
glossary.ModelRegistry: A package-level map from model ID strings to ModelEntry values.
glossary.ModelTier: A string type classifying LLM models by capability level: SIMPLE, STANDARD, or ADVANCED.
glossary.NewSpecAgent: Constructor function that creates a SpecAgent with the given model tier string.
glossary.OnArtifact: A callback function invoked by GenerateArtifacts after each artifact is successfully validated, with the artifact name and content.
glossary.RefinePRD: A SpecAgent method that sends a PRD with user answers and prior assessment to the LLM, returning an updated PRD text and new Assessment.
glossary.RefinementSystemPrompt: A function that loads the refinement_system prompt template.
glossary.RefinementUserPrompt: A function that loads and renders the refinement_user prompt template.
glossary.RepairUserPrompt: A function that loads and renders the repair_user prompt template for validation error repair loops.
glossary.ResolveModel: A function that resolves a model name or tier constant string to a canonical model ID.
glossary.SpecAgent: A struct that holds the model tier and implements the AI agent pipeline methods: AssessPRD, RefinePRD, and GenerateArtifacts.
glossary.SpecSession: Go struct representing the stateful session for authoring a single spec, persisted to _session.json.
glossary.StateAssessing: SessionState indicating the session is undergoing PRD quality assessment.
glossary.StateGenerated: SessionState indicating all artifacts have been successfully generated.
glossary.StateGenerating: SessionState indicating artifact generation is in progress.
glossary.StateRefining: SessionState indicating the session is in iterative Q&A refinement.
glossary.TierAdvanced: The ADVANCED model tier constant, mapped to claude-opus-4-6 by default.
glossary.TierDefaults: A package-level map from ModelTier to the default model ID string for that tier.
glossary.TierSimple: The SIMPLE model tier constant, mapped to claude-haiku-4-5 by default.
glossary.TierStandard: The STANDARD model tier constant, mapped to claude-sonnet-4-6 by default.
glossary.Validate: The afspec function that runs schema and cross-file validation on a spec package.
glossary.WithDependentInterfaces: AgentOption that sets the dependent spec interfaces slice for agent methods.
glossary.WithOnArtifact: AgentOption that sets a callback invoked after each artifact is successfully generated.
glossary.WithProjectDir: AgentOption that sets the project directory for agent methods.
glossary.WithSpecLandscape: AgentOption that sets the spec landscape slice for agent methods.
glossary.YAML frontmatter: Metadata content between --- delimiters at the start of a prompt template file, stripped before use.
glossary.afspec: The Go library for loading, validating, mutating, and rendering agent-fox specification packages.
glossary.assessment_block: A formatted block representing a prior Assessment, injected into the refinement_user prompt template.
glossary.exponential backoff: A retry strategy with increasing delays between attempts: 2s, 30s, 60s, for a total of 4 attempts.
glossary.generatedArtifacts: The list of artifact names recorded in SpecSession state after successful generation.
glossary.priorArtifacts: A map of previously generated artifact names to their content, passed to GenerationUserPrompt to provide context for subsequent artifact generation.
glossary.qa_block: A formatted block of question-answer pairs injected into the refinement_user prompt template.
glossary.repair loop: An iterative process in GenerateArtifacts that re-sends validation errors and original content to the LLM to obtain a corrected artifact, up to 2 attempts.
glossary.spec_landscape_block: A formatted markdown block representing the current spec landscape, injected into prompt templates.
glossary.submit_assessment: Anthropic tool name used during assessment; accepts quality, summary, gaps, and questions.
glossary.submit_prd_update: Anthropic tool name used during refinement; accepts an updated_prd string.
glossary.token threshold: The estimated token count above which cache_control is injected on the system prompt: 2048 for sonnet models, 4096 for opus/haiku models.
glossary.<projectDir>/.spec/prompts/<name>.md: The filesystem path pattern for project-local prompt template overrides. LoadPrompt checks this location before falling back to embedded defaults.
glossary.$spec_landscape_block: A template variable in prompt templates that is substituted with the formatted spec landscape markdown block produced by FormatSpecLandscape.
glossary.$qa_block: A template variable in prompt templates that is substituted with formatted question-answer pairs from previous refinement exchanges.
glossary.$assessment_block: A template variable in prompt templates that is substituted with a formatted block representing the prior Assessment struct fields.
glossary.NewSpecAgent(modelTier string) *SpecAgen: Constructor function signature for creating a SpecAgent with the given model tier string, returning a pointer to the new SpecAgent.
glossary.AssessmentTools(): Function call returning the Anthropic tool definitions for the submit_assessment tool, as defined in the agentspec_go_core spec.
glossary.WithOnArtifact(func(name string, content: Functional option constructor signature that sets an artifact callback on SpecAgent methods, invoked after each artifact is successfully generated.
glossary.WithDependentInterfaces([]map[string]any: Functional option constructor signature that sets the dependent spec interfaces slice for SpecAgent methods.
glossary.WithSpecLandscape([]map[string]any): Functional option constructor signature that sets the spec landscape slice for SpecAgent methods.
glossary.WithProjectDir(string): Functional option constructor signature that sets the project directory for SpecAgent methods.
glossary.ResolveModel(name): Function call that resolves a model name or tier constant string to a canonical Anthropic model ID string.
glossary.(*SpecSession).Generate: Method on the SpecSession pointer receiver that transitions to StateGenerating, calls GenerateArtifacts, writes artifacts to disk, transitions to StateGenerated, and returns a GenerateResult.

user_story.role: Go developer using the agentspec package
user_story.goal: resolve a human-readable model name or tier constant to a canonical Anthropic model ID
user_story.benefit: so that callers can specify models by capability tier without hardcoding model IDs

acceptance_criteria.action: defines `ModelTier` as a string type with constants `TierSimple` ("SIMPLE"), `TierStandard` ("STANDARD"), and `TierAdvanced` ("ADVANCED"); defines `ModelEntry` struct with fields ModelID (string), Tier (`ModelTier`), and Variant (string); exposes `ModelRegistry` as a package-level map from model ID strings to `ModelEntry` with initial entries for claude-haiku-4-5 (`TierSimple`), claude-sonnet-4-6 (`TierStandard`), and claude-opus-4-6 (`TierAdvanced`); exposes `TierDefaults` as a package-level map from `ModelTier` to default model ID string
returns the default model ID for that tier from `TierDefaults`
acceptance_criteria.trigger: called with a name matching a tier constant (case-insensitive)

acceptance_criteria.action: returns the model ID directly
acceptance_criteria.trigger: called with a name matching a model ID key in `ModelRegistry`

acceptance_criteria.action: returns an empty string and a descriptive error
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns ("", error) with a message indicating the name was not recognized
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: unrecognized model name — the name matches neither a tier constant nor a `ModelRegistry` key

edge_cases.action: returns an error indicating the model name is empty
performs case-insensitive comparison and returns the correct default model ID
edge_cases.trigger: called with a tier constant in mixed case (e.g. "standard")

user_story.goal: send prompts to the Anthropic API with streaming, retry, and prompt caching
user_story.benefit: so that all LLM calls share a single, robust, platform-aware interface

acceptance_criteria.action: resolves the model tier to a model ID via `ResolveModel`, creates a platform-aware Anthropic client (checking `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX` then `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK` then falling back to direct API with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`), streams the response, and returns the complete response text
acceptance_criteria.trigger: invoked with valid `AICallOptions`

acceptance_criteria.action: defaults MaxTokens to 65536 and `CachePolicy` to `CacheDefault` when not specified in `AICallOptions`
retries with `exponential backoff` delays of 2s, 30s, and 60s between attempts (4 total attempts)
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns (responseText string, rawResponse any, nil) on eventual success
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the API returns a rate limit error, 5xx server error, or connection error
acceptance_criteria.condition: the attempt count is fewer than 4

acceptance_criteria.action: injects cache_control on the last system message block: {"type": "ephemeral"} for `CacheDefault`, adds {"ttl": "1h"} for `CacheExtended`
acceptance_criteria.trigger: `CachePolicy` is not `CacheNone` and the system prompt text length divided by 4 exceeds the model-specific `token threshold`
acceptance_criteria.condition: the model is a sonnet model (threshold 2048) or an opus/haiku model (threshold 4096)

acceptance_criteria.action: retries the same request without cache_control
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns (responseText string, rawResponse any, nil) on success after retry, or ("", nil, error) if the retry also fails
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: cache_control rejection by the Anthropic API — the API rejects the request due to the injected cache_control

acceptance_criteria.action: returns an empty string, nil raw response, and the last error wrapped as an `AgentError`
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns ("", nil, AgentError) with the appropriate category and retryable=false
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: persistent API failure after maximum retries — all 4 retry attempts are exhausted

edge_cases.action: stops streaming, releases the connection, and returns an error immediately without further retries
edge_cases.return_contract: returns ("", nil, error) wrapping the context error
edge_cases.error_condition: context cancellation or timeout — the context is cancelled or deadline exceeded before the streaming response completes

edge_cases.action: returns an error before making any API call
edge_cases.return_contract: returns ("", nil, AgentError) with category auth
edge_cases.error_condition: missing API credentials — `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is empty and neither `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX` nor `CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK` is set

edge_cases.action: returns an error describing the missing field
edge_cases.error_condition: unexpected API response shape — the streaming API returns a success status but the response body is missing the expected text content field

edge_cases.action: never calls os.Exit or panics; all errors are returned to the caller via the error return value

user_story.benefit: so that the session can record a structured Assessment and decide whether to proceed to refinement or generation

acceptance_criteria.action: defines `SpecAgent` struct with a modelTier string field and `NewSpecAgent(modelTier string) *SpecAgent` constructor

builds system and user prompts via `AssessmentSystemPrompt` and `AssessmentUserPrompt`, calls `AICall` with `AssessmentTools()` and tool_choice {"type": "any"}, checks the stop reason, extracts the `submit_assessment` tool call, parses and validates the `Assessment` struct, and returns it

acceptance_criteria.action: returns an `AgentError` with the appropriate category

requirements.title: GenerateArtifacts sequential pipeline with repair loop

user_story.goal: generate requirements, test_spec, and tasks artifacts sequentially with validation and repair
user_story.benefit: so that all three artifacts are produced in a single call with schema-valid content

acceptance_criteria.action: generates requirements, test_spec, and tasks sequentially; for each artifact builds the prompt with `priorArtifacts` context, calls `AICall` with temperature=0.2 and the artifact-specific tool, extracts the tool call result, validates via JSON unmarshal into the Go struct and `afspec` schema/cross-file validation, and invokes the `OnArtifact` callback if set
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns (map[string]any of artifactName to validated content, nil) on success
acceptance_criteria.trigger: called with a context, prdText, specID, specName, and optional `AgentOption` values

acceptance_criteria.action: sends validation errors and original content via `RepairUserPrompt` to the LLM, re-extracts the tool call, re-validates, and repeats up to 2 repair attempts
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns the repaired artifact in the result map on success
acceptance_criteria.trigger: validation of an artifact fails
acceptance_criteria.condition: the `repair loop` attempt count is fewer than 2

acceptance_criteria.action: returns an error for the failed artifact without generating subsequent artifacts
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns (nil, error) describing which artifact failed and the final validation errors
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: repair loop exhausted — validation still fails after 2 repair attempts

acceptance_criteria.action: passes all previously generated artifacts as `priorArtifacts` context when building the prompt for each subsequent artifact, so each generation step has progressively richer context

edge_cases.action: returns immediately with the context error; already-generated artifacts are not written to disk by the agent (the `OnArtifact` callback is responsible for persistence)
edge_cases.error_condition: context cancellation mid-generation — the context is cancelled during any artifact generation or repair call

edge_cases.action: recovers from the panic or propagates the error and stops generation
edge_cases.return_contract: returns (nil, error) describing the callback failure
edge_cases.error_condition: artifact callback failure — the `OnArtifact` callback panics or returns an error

edge_cases.action: treats the unmarshal failure as a validation error and enters the `repair loop`
edge_cases.return_contract: returns repaired artifact on success, or (nil, error) after repair loop exhaustion
edge_cases.error_condition: malformed artifact payload from LLM — the LLM returns a success response but the tool call payload cannot be JSON-unmarshalled into the expected artifact struct

edge_cases.action: caps the `repair loop` at exactly 2 attempts per artifact regardless of the nature of the validation error, preventing unbounded iteration

edge_cases.return_contract: returns (GenerateResult{ArtifactList, ValidationResult with errors, Warnings}, nil)
edge_cases.error_condition: post-generation validation errors — `Validate` returns validation errors after all artifacts are generated

edge_cases.action: skips all generation, transitions to `StateGenerated`, runs `Validate`, and returns `GenerateResult` with the existing artifacts
edge_cases.trigger: all three artifact files already exist on disk

correctness_properties.title: ResolveModel is total on valid inputs
correctness_properties.for_any: name string that is a valid tier constant (case-insensitive) or a key in `ModelRegistry`
correctness_properties.invariant: `ResolveModel(name)` returns a non-empty model ID string and a nil error

correctness_properties.title: ResolveModel rejects all unrecognized names
correctness_properties.for_any: name string that is neither a tier constant nor a `ModelRegistry` key
correctness_properties.invariant: `ResolveModel(name)` returns an empty string and a non-nil error

correctness_properties.title: AICall retry count is bounded
correctness_properties.invariant: `AICall` makes at most 4 total attempts before returning an error, regardless of the number of consecutive transient failures

correctness_properties.title: Cache injection is threshold-gated
correctness_properties.for_any: system prompt text of any length and any `CachePolicy` value
correctness_properties.invariant: cache_control is injected if and only if `CachePolicy` is not `CacheNone` and the estimated token count (len(text)/4) exceeds the model-specific `token threshold`

correctness_properties.title: LoadPrompt name validation prevents path traversal
correctness_properties.invariant: `LoadPrompt` returns a non-nil error and reads no file from disk

correctness_properties.title: LoadPromptTemplate safe substitution preserves unmatched variables
correctness_properties.for_any: template content containing $variable references and a vars map missing some keys
correctness_properties.invariant: the returned string contains the unmatched $variable references verbatim and all matched references are replaced

correctness_properties.title: GenerateArtifacts repair loop is bounded
correctness_properties.for_any: artifact that fails validation on every attempt
correctness_properties.invariant: `GenerateArtifacts` makes at most 2 repair attempts per artifact before returning an error

correctness_properties.title: SpecSession methods never call os.Exit
correctness_properties.for_any: any error condition in Assess, Refine, or Generate
correctness_properties.invariant: the method returns an error value to the caller and never terminates the process directly

correctness_properties.title: Refine does not record QA exchange on failure
correctness_properties.for_any: any error returned by RefinePRD or the PRD file write
correctness_properties.invariant: no QA exchange is appended to session state and the PRD file on disk is not modified

correctness_properties.title: Generate partial recovery skips existing artifacts
correctness_properties.for_any: any subset of the three artifact files already present on disk
correctness_properties.invariant: `(*SpecSession).Generate` only calls `GenerateArtifacts` for artifacts whose files do not already exist

execution_paths.title: Full end-to-end spec authoring: assess, refine, generate

steps.action: user runs `spec session start` with a PRD file; CLI creates a SpecSession via agentspec_go_core and calls Assess(ctx)
transitions to StateAssessing, loads spec landscape from sibling specs, creates a SpecAgent
calls AssessPRD: builds assessment prompts, calls AICall with AssessmentTools() and tool_choice any
resolves model tier, creates platform-aware Anthropic client, streams response with retry and prompt caching
extracts submit_assessment tool call, parses and validates Assessment struct, returns it
appends Assessment to history, persists state to disk, returns Assessment to CLI
presents assessment questions to user, collects answers, calls Refine(ctx, answers)
transitions to StateRefining, calls RefinePRD with current PRD text, answers, and latest assessment
calls AICall with refinement tools, extracts submit_prd_update and submit_assessment tool calls
writes updated PRD to disk, records QA exchange, appends new Assessment, persists state
user confirms PRD is ready; CLI calls Generate(ctx)
transitions to StateGenerating, checks for existing artifact files, calls GenerateArtifacts with OnArtifact callback
generates requirements, test_spec, tasks sequentially; runs repair loop on validation failures; invokes OnArtifact callback after each
OnArtifact callback writes each artifact to disk via afspec MarshalJSON, records in generatedArtifacts
transitions to StateGenerated, runs Validate, returns GenerateResult with artifact list, validation result, and warnings to CLI

execution_paths.title: AICall with Vertex AI platform and prompt caching

steps.action: calls AICall with AICallOptions specifying TierStandard, a long system prompt, and CacheDefault
resolves TierStandard to claude-sonnet-4-6 via ResolveModel
detects CLAUDE_CODE_USE_VERTEX is set, creates a Vertex AI Anthropic client
estimates system prompt tokens via len(text)/4; exceeds 2048 threshold for sonnet; injects cache_control {"type": "ephemeral"} on the last system message block
streams the response from the Vertex AI endpoint, collecting the complete text
returns (responseText, rawResponse, nil) to the SpecAgent caller
calls GenerateArtifacts for the requirements artifact
builds generation prompt via GenerationUserPrompt with empty priorArtifacts, calls AICall with temperature=0.2 and requirements tool
returns LLM response with requirements tool call payload
JSON-unmarshals payload into requirements struct; afspec schema validation fails with errors
enters repair loop: calls RepairUserPrompt with validation errors and original content, calls AICall again
returns repaired requirements payload
re-validates repaired payload; validation passes; invokes OnArtifact callback with requirements content
OnArtifact callback writes requirements artifact to disk via afspec MarshalJSON and records it in generatedArtifacts
calls AssessmentSystemPrompt with a projectDir that contains a custom assessment_system.md override
validates the name against [a-zA-Z0-9_-]+, checks for a non-symlink file at <projectDir>/.spec/prompts/assessment_system.md
reads the override file, strips YAML frontmatter, and returns the custom prompt content
returns the custom prompt content to the SpecAgent caller

error_handling.condition: AICall exhausts all 4 retry attempts due to persistent transient errors
error_handling.behavior: returns ("", nil, AgentError) with the last error, appropriate category, and retryable=false

error_handling.condition: AICall context is cancelled or deadline exceeded
error_handling.behavior: stops streaming immediately, releases the connection, and returns ("", nil, error) wrapping the context error without further retries

error_handling.condition: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is empty and no platform override env vars are set
error_handling.behavior: returns ("", nil, AgentError) with category auth before making any API call

error_handling.condition: LoadPrompt called with a name containing characters outside [a-zA-Z0-9_-]
error_handling.behavior: returns ("", error) with a message indicating the name is invalid, without reading any file

error_handling.condition: LoadPrompt override path exists but is a symlink
error_handling.behavior: ignores the symlink and falls back to the embedded default template, returning (embeddedContent, nil)

error_handling.condition: AssessPRD receives a refusal, context_window_exceeded, or pause_turn stop reason
error_handling.behavior: returns (Assessment{}, AgentError) with the matching category without attempting tool call extraction

error_handling.condition: AssessPRD response contains no submit_assessment tool call
error_handling.behavior: returns (Assessment{}, AgentError{Category: "internal"}) describing the missing tool call

error_handling.condition: RefinePRD response contains neither submit_prd_update nor submit_assessment tool calls
GenerateArtifacts validation fails after 2 repair attempts for an artifact
error_handling.behavior: returns (nil, error) describing which artifact failed and the final validation errors; subsequent artifacts are not generated

error_handling.condition: SpecSession.Assess fails due to AssessPRD error
error_handling.behavior: persists the error as lastError in session state and returns (Assessment{}, error) without appending to assessment history

error_handling.condition: SpecSession.Refine fails due to RefinePRD error or PRD file write error
error_handling.behavior: persists the error as lastError, does not update PRD file, does not record QA exchange, returns (Assessment{}, error)

error_handling.condition: SpecSession.Generate fails due to GenerateArtifacts error or OnArtifact callback error
error_handling.behavior: does not transition to StateGenerated, persists the error as lastError, returns (GenerateResult{}, error)

error_handling.condition: GenerationUserPrompt called with an unrecognized artifactName
error_handling.behavior: returns ("", error) indicating the artifact name is not supported

error_handling.condition: AICall streaming response returns success status but missing expected text content field
error_handling.behavior: returns ("", rawResponse, error) describing the missing field
